All disqualifying conditions are absent: (a5) the donation was not made through Payroll Giving; (a6) it was not a payment for goods or services; (a7) Elaine received no benefit in exchange; (a8) it was not a transfer of shares; (a9) it was a direct bank transfer, explicitly distinct from CAF voucher or charity card payments. Therefore Gift Aid can be claimed on this donation. Note: this determination applies specifically to FP-0316-EL; other donations from other donors would require separate assessment.","scope_issues":["The determination applies only to donation FP-0316-EL (Elaine Carter, 16 March 2026). The charity also receives monthly direct-debit donations and other one-off donations from other donors; each would need to be assessed individually against the same conditions, particularly the tax-paid threshold (a3) and Gift Aid declaration (a4) requirements."],"ir_discrepancies":[],"conditional_branches":[]}
